description: This Kotlin source file defines the ActivityViewModel class, which manages UI-related data and operations for a note-taking app, including note manipulation, media handling, and preferences.

classes.name: ActivityViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing notes, media, and preferences in a note-taking app.

methods.name: syncAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously synchronizes notes with remote storage.

methods.name: discardEmptyNotesAsync
methods.description: Discards empty notes asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteNotesPermanently
methods.description: Permanently deletes specified notes and cancels associated reminders.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Deletes or moves notes to bin based on user preferences.

methods.name: restoreNotes
methods.description: Restores deleted notes, showing error message if failure occurs.

methods.name: archiveNotes
methods.description: Archives specified notes.

methods.name: unarchiveNotes
methods.description: Unarchives specified notes.

methods.name: showNotes
methods.description: Makes notes visible.

methods.name: hideNotes
methods.description: Hides specified notes.

methods.name: pinNotes
methods.description: Pins or unpins notes.

methods.name: compactPreviewNotes
methods.description: Sets notes to compact preview mode.

methods.name: fullPreviewNotes
methods.description: Sets notes to full preview mode.

methods.name: moveNotes
methods.description: Moves notes to a specified notebook.

methods.name: makeNotesSyncable
methods.description: Marks notes as syncable.

methods.name: makeNotesLocal
methods.description: Marks notes as local only.

methods.name: makeNotesFullPreview
methods.description: Sets notes to full preview mode.

methods.name: makeNotesCompactPreview
methods.description: Sets notes to compact preview mode.

methods.name: disableScreenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Disables always-on screen for notes.

methods.name: enableScreenAlwaysOn
methods.description: Enables always-on screen for notes.

methods.name: disableMarkdown
methods.description: Disables markdown rendering for notes.

methods.name: enableMarkdown
methods.description: Enables markdown rendering for notes.

methods.name: duplicateNotes
methods.description: Duplicates specified notes, copying tags and reminders.

methods.name: setLayoutMode
methods.description: Sets the layout mode preference.

methods.name: setSortMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for notes.

methods.name: setSortTagsMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for tags.

methods.name: setSortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
methods.description: Sets the sorting method for nav drawer notebooks.

methods.name: createImageFile
methods.description: Creates a new image file Uri.

methods.name: copyMediaToPrivateStorage
methods.description: Copies media from a source Uri to app's private storage, returning new Uri.
